content: Bepaŋ tiŋa metamŋiye diniŋ mede kahat
Metamneye, hidi medene yodakalelat u momooŋgoŋ hinek nadineŋ. Hidi nu mede yobe tilat wendok magi kametnadi fofooŋgoŋ tineŋ.
Nu adi yoyout mede yobit, eŋ nemenemek komi kabup hebihalibulak wendok maaŋ kahat tihambit.
Koom mamani-papaniyedi nemek wondok agaŋ ninimbune magi kametnadi tiŋa nadigumun.

Indi wapmihiniye mu yeniŋa mede u yalihefula adi mu tineem. Adi toboniŋ yalakiniye tomboyoula mintaneeŋ u Yahwe’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ wapum eŋ kwanai saŋiniŋnit tuguk eŋ kunumneniŋ kudi tuguk u mede kahat tiyemne nadineeŋ.

Bepaŋdi Isilaehi metamdok Yodoko Medeŋiŋ yemguk. Tiŋa Jekop yalakiŋiyedi takalidok yoŋa mede yeniŋguk. Adi koom mamaŋ-papaŋ heki indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi wapmihihiye nu’walaŋ Yodoko Medene i momooŋgoŋ hinek yenindidimeyaneeŋ.”
Unduŋ tineeŋ doktiŋa wapmihi-bop mindaŋ mintaneeŋ adi maaŋ nadineeŋ, ala adibo yakaleeŋ wapmihihiye yenineeŋ.
Unduŋ tineeŋ doktiŋa adi maaŋ Bepaŋ nadisukilitimineeŋ, tiŋa adi nemenemek hogohogok tuguk u nadikaule tuwot mu tineeŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa adi’walaŋ Yodoko Medeŋiŋ hogohogok u kedem yehikeleneeŋ.

Tiyaugene mamahi-papahiyedok tuwolit mintaneeneŋ ala. Mamaŋ-papaŋ heki adi foko tiŋa Bepaŋ’walaŋ medeŋiŋ kahaŋinda tigiŋ, unduŋ tiŋa Bepaŋ nadisukilitimiŋ hinek mu tigiŋ, eŋ medeŋiŋ maaŋ undugoŋ helemahelemaŋ hinek mu takaliyagiŋ.
Koom Ifeleimhi adi tebe bohom tiŋa tiulidokogiŋ. Iŋgoŋ mik pilalune toboniŋ momoŋ tiŋa ugiŋ.
Adi yadi Bepaŋ dut yofolok tigiŋ u mu takaligiŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ Yodoko Medeŋiŋ takalidok adi nadilakata tigiŋ.
Adi yadi Bepaŋdi nemenemek tuguk be kunumneniŋ kudi dauhik foloŋgoŋ tubune yabugiŋ u agaŋ kaule tigiŋ.
Isip kwetneŋ kwet gutuŋ niŋ wou Soan, uŋoŋ Bepaŋdi kunumneniŋ kudi niŋ tubune mamani-papaniye adi dauhikdi hinek kagiŋ.
Bepaŋdi imeŋgwaŋ ulitawaune fukufukuŋ looŋ yalune Isilaehi metam yanagilune lekiŋgoŋ uŋgoŋ bugiŋ.
Hadapmo adi mulukwaŋ gineŋ hali talitimeŋ tiyemguk, eŋ timiŋ adi kudup hautaŋiŋ gineŋ hali talitimeŋ tiyemguk.
Adi kwet fiileŋ uŋoŋ kawade heki upupuheneune ime kwet kainiŋneniŋ sila labuŋa woditaune nagiŋ.
Adi yobune ime kawade gineniŋ labuŋa ime wapuhi behepneŋ wodiŋa wiiŋ nabugoŋ wodiŋa uguk.
Iŋgoŋ adi yadi Bepaŋ loloŋnitdok kadakaniŋ hati timiyagiŋ. Adi kwet fiileŋ uŋoŋ hatiŋila foko hati-timiyagiŋ.
Adi Bepaŋ tikamanda timindok nadiŋa unduŋ tagiŋ. Adi nanaŋe dediniŋdok hinek nadiyagiŋ uŋak yembek yoŋa gibitaŋ kutiniyagiŋ.
Adi Bepaŋ nimpekit tiŋa indiŋ yoyagiŋ, “Kwet fiileŋ iŋoŋ Bepaŋdi nanaŋe mohok tuwot hinek kedembe nimbek?
Koom kawade foloŋ ulune ime wapum u biyagoŋ wodiguk. Iŋgoŋ nanaŋe tiŋa kale u kedem-kube nimbek?”
Unduŋ yoŋa tobune Yahwe adi medehik u nadiŋa kwihita tuguk. Doktiŋa kudup kameune Isilaehi’walaŋ foguk. Tiŋa kwihita kisaŋ hinek tiyemguk.
Adi mu nadisukilitimiŋgiŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ adi yehitubu-lodaune momooŋ hatidok nadiŋa tuguk wendok maaŋ mu nadisukilitigiŋ, doktiŋa unduŋ tiyemguk.
Iŋgoŋ fiit yobune kunum dilitomguk.
Kaŋ yobune mana kwetfoloŋ maaŋ foune moŋgola nagiŋ. Adi kunumneniŋ nanaŋe yembune nagiŋ.
Unduŋ doktiŋa adi aŋelo heki’walaŋ nanaŋe nagiŋ. Bepaŋdi nanaŋe tuwot hinek yembune natoki tigiŋ.
Kaŋ mindaŋ mele labulabuneŋkade yobune sububa wapum fedikuk, eŋ ne’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ gineŋgoŋ yobune sububa saut-kade maaŋ fedikuk.
Kaŋ negoŋ yobune bagi mohok fee mumuyeŋ kwamdok tuwolit, eŋ kiŋ luhineŋ ikiiŋdok tuwolit wendi adi’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ maaŋ fotelegiŋ.
Bepaŋ ne nadiune bagi hekidi maaŋ fooŋ metamdi yot maaŋ ila ugiŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ fogiŋ, eŋ seli-yot haliugiŋ u kelemadidapmaŋ tiŋa hakiŋ.
Kaŋ metamdi u beŋa henaŋ tuwot hinek nadigiŋ. Bepaŋdi nemek yemdok nadiŋa kutiniŋgiŋ u uŋakoŋ yemguk.
Kaŋ uŋakoŋ hati-nagiŋ. Iŋgoŋ mu nadapmalune,
nai uŋaniŋgoŋ Bepaŋdi kwihita tiyemiŋa me fafaŋehi u widihikumuŋ tuguk, Isilaehi’walaŋ mekuya momohi.
Bepaŋ adi kunumneniŋ kudi fee tuguk, iŋgoŋ metamdi yabuhaŋindaaŋ tomboyoula kadakaniŋ fee tiŋila Bepaŋ mu nadisukilitimiŋgiŋ.
Wendoktiŋa Bepaŋdi meeniŋ mahik foloŋ munabut tubune sububadi labuŋa pilap hinek fitak wondok tuwolit pilap hinek yehitubu-liwe tuguk. Adi pilap hinek yehitubu-kadakaune kumuŋ tigiŋ.
Bepaŋdi noli widihi-kumuŋguk, kaŋ nai uŋaniŋ me noli welehik tubutakaleeŋ adi’walaŋkade buŋa ninadi kwanai gibitaŋ tigiŋ.
Nai uŋaniŋ Bepaŋdi yahehewe tiyemiŋa momooŋ hinek yabudokolak eŋ Bepaŋ loloŋnit hinek adi momooŋ yehitubu-lodalak u kotigoŋ naditomgiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ u yalaŋ timiŋa niŋkamanda tigiŋ.
Unduŋ tiŋa adi’walaŋ medeŋiŋ mu takaligiŋ, eŋ adigut yofolok tigiŋ u bikabugiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ Bepaŋ adi metamŋiyedok siloŋ tobogoŋ tiyemiŋa kadakaniŋhik tumolokula mu yehitubu-kadakaguk. Nai fee hinek kwihitaŋiŋ u fiit honekilitiŋa hali nadikwihita mu tiyemiluguk.
Aditok indiŋ nadiyemiluguk, adi yadi nemek fafaŋehi mokoŋ, adi yadi meeniŋ, tiŋa undugoŋ adi yadi sububadi fedila buŋa dapmaaŋ ulak undihi.
Nai fee hinek kwet fiileŋ uŋoŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ medeŋiŋ nadihaŋinda timiŋgiŋ. Unduŋ timimbune adi nai fee hinek welemulap nadiluguk.
Adi Bepaŋ tikamanda timindok nadiŋa nemek tagiŋ uŋakoŋ tiyakaleeŋ kotigoŋ tagiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa Isilaehi’walaŋ Bepaŋ Uŋgoniŋ weleŋ tubukadakayagiŋ.
Adi Bepaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ loloŋnit, tiŋa memik heki’walaŋ kohohik gineniŋ yehitubu-lodaaŋ kotigoŋ yanagikuk u mu naditomgiŋ.
Isip kwetneŋ kwet gutuŋ niŋ wou Soan, uŋoŋ kunumneniŋ kudi fee tuguk.
Bepaŋdi ime nadiune naŋgat yageleune Isiphi adi ime tuwot mu nagiŋ.
Tiŋa bubugaim eŋ hawom mohok fee nadiune adi’walaŋkade ugiŋ. Wooŋ bubugaimdi yehisigiŋ eŋ hawom hekidi yohikkwehik tubukadakagiŋ.
Eŋ Bepaŋdi kaleŋgiŋgiŋ tiŋa gwatak yeniŋkulune buŋa dininahik gineŋ nemenemek labugiŋ u nadapmaŋ tigiŋ.
Tiŋa undugoŋ negoŋ nadiune gwi ais nabugoŋ wondi maaŋ wain tawahik u yehitubu-kadakagiŋ, eŋ nadiune aisdi bem gimiŋ fik u yehitubu-kadaka tuguk.
Tiŋa nadiune gwi ais nabugoŋ maaŋ makauhik u widihikumuŋdapmaŋ tuguk, eŋ filimpitdi dompahiye widihikumuŋ-dapmaguk.
Adi kwihita kisaŋgoŋ hinek tiyemiŋa gibitaŋ yehitubu-kadakaguk. Unduŋ tiŋa aŋelo fafaŋehi yapmeune wooŋ yehitubu-kadakagiŋ kaŋ adi malabumuŋ wapum nadigiŋ.
Adi kwihita tiyemiŋa mu biyabuguk. Mokoŋ. Adi toboniŋ nadiune yagit wapumdi yohoneune kumuŋ fotaba tigiŋ.
Eŋ Isiphi’walaŋ tuwo biyeniŋ hogohogok u widihikumuŋdapmaŋ tuguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa dompa kadoko me nabugoŋ talitimeŋ tiŋa metamŋiye yanagikuk. Tiŋa kwet fiileŋ uŋoŋ talik yenindidimeeŋ yahaŋeguk.
Adi momooŋ hinek tiŋa yahaŋeguk, doktiŋa adi munta mu tigiŋ. Iŋgoŋ memikhiye adi imeŋgwaŋdi yehikumuyeguk.
Adi yahaŋeune ne’walaŋ kweli uŋgoniŋ gineŋ bugiŋ, kweboboe woŋ adi ne’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ gineŋ fafaŋeeŋ kahileguk.
Adi metamŋiye bugiŋ kaŋ metam noli uŋoŋ hatigiŋ u yehikelekukuk. Unduŋ tiŋa kwet u Isilaehi mebopdok daneyemtauguk. Unduŋ tiŋa yohik hogohogok u metamŋiyedok yembune yohikwehineŋ kulemaŋgoŋ itougiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ Isilaehi adi Bepaŋ Saŋiniŋ Molom u tikamanda timiŋa foko timiŋgiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa Yodoko Medeŋiŋ u mu takaligiŋ.
Adi yadi mamahi-papahiyedi koom tigiŋ wendok tuwot foko tiŋa medeŋiŋdok nadilakata tigiŋ. Adi yadi tebemiŋ gembugolohi nabugoŋ tigiŋ.
Adi bepaŋ yalayalaŋ heki’walaŋ welewele eŋ altahik tutumbaune Bepaŋ adi wendoktiŋa kwihita tuguk.
Bepaŋ adi titiŋhik u kaŋ kwihita kisaŋ hinek tiyemguk, unduŋ doktiŋa Isilaehi adi sigilulum tiyemiŋa biyabudapmaŋ tuguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa Sailo uŋoŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ Siloŋyot selidi magiŋ u bikabu tuguk. Yot wendok foloŋ adi metam’walaŋ lekiŋgoŋhik gineŋ hatiguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa memik heki biyabune buŋa yofolok bogit u tiŋa ugiŋ. Bogit wendok gineŋ adi ne’walaŋ saŋiniŋŋiŋ tiŋa namanda diniŋ hauta wapum u kayagiŋ.
Adi metamŋiye yabukwihita tiŋa biyabune memikhiyedi buŋa widihi-kumuŋgiŋ.
Mekuya adi mik gineŋ kumuŋdapmagiŋ, doktiŋa tamkuyadi yohohiye titiŋdok me nemu hatigiŋ.
Memik hekidi Siloŋyot diniŋ talitimeŋ heki u miknoŋdi widihi-kumuŋgiŋ, kaŋ tamhiye adi yohohiyedok bulaniŋgoŋ nadigiŋ iŋgoŋ e, makat mu kokiŋ.
Kaŋ Wapum adi me niŋdi damo gineniŋ pilatak nabugoŋ pilakuk, eŋ me fafaŋeeŋ niŋdi wain ime fee naaŋ kakali yaulak wendok tuwot tuguk.
Adi memik heki gut mindobuŋa kotigoŋ yehikeleune ugiŋ. Unduŋ tiŋa yehikalakapme hinek tubune adi mekadapmaaŋ mik kotigoŋ mu tigiŋ.
Tiŋa adi yadi Josep’walaŋ yalakiŋiyedok moŋ nadiyemiŋa yeniŋkelekut tuguk. Tiŋa undugoŋ Ifeleim’walaŋ yalakiŋiye maaŋ adi yabukahile mu tuguk.
Adi yadi tobo Juda’walaŋ yalakiŋiye tiŋa Saiyon kweboboe, ne weleŋdi kahile tilak, adi netok gigit yofafaŋeguk.
Adi yoli uŋgoniŋ kweboboe wendok foloŋ maguk, tiŋa yoli u tubufafaŋeune kunumdi fafaŋeniŋ hatak eŋ kwet i kamekwambundaguk kaŋ hatak wondok tuwot fafaŋeeŋ yatak.
Bepaŋdi tipilapilaye-meŋiŋ Dewit adi dompa hati yabudokolune nagila metamŋiye yabudokodok yoŋa kahileguk.
Unduŋ tiŋa Isilaehi’walaŋ mapme kameguk, kaŋ Bepaŋ metamŋiye yabudoko kwanai tuluguk.
Dewit adi kwanaiŋiŋdok hogok nadinadi tiŋa momooŋ hinek yabudokoluguk. Unduŋ tiŋa talitimeŋ momooŋ hatiguk.
